name: HydroGraph Clean Power Inc.
summary: HydroGraph Clean Power Inc. engages in the acquisition and development of graphene and hydrogen related products and services. The company is involved in the research, development, marketing, and commercialization of patented technology to produce pristine graphene, graphene derivatives, and services, as well as hydrogen, syngas, and other products. HydroGraph Clean Power Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
